verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is an API-first, server-to-server service. Its documented APIs (Feed API batch uploads, Cart API session operations, ACP/UCP token flows), OpenAPI definitions and webhooks can all be driven programmatically without a UI. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines, test environments or non-interactive automation tooling. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline usage, a test/sandbox environment for automated runs, CLI or headless tooling, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You upload product data in batches of up to 200 items.
Adyen communicates with your server so that you do not need to integrate with multiple agent platforms.
With webhooks, you can avoid having to continuously poll an API endpoint, waiting for a change in status for an asynchronous process
If you prefer to use the classic Swagger toolset, upload these definitions to the Swagger Editor or SwaggerHub.
